scripts.build:launcher: cargo build --release --manifest-path launcher/Cargo.toml && cp launcher/target/release/aiot dist/aiot
scripts.build:darwin-arm64: bun build src/cli.ts --compile --target bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/aiot-runtime-darwin-arm64 && cargo build --release --manifest-path launcher/Cargo.toml --target aarch64-apple-darwin && cp launcher/target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/aiot dist/aiot-darwin-arm64
scripts.build:darwin-x64: bun build src/cli.ts --compile --target bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/aiot-runtime-darwin-x64 && cargo build --release --manifest-path launcher/Cargo.toml --target x86_64-apple-darwin && cp launcher/target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/aiot dist/aiot-darwin-x64
scripts.build:linux-x64: bun build src/cli.ts --compile --target bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/aiot-runtime-linux-x64 && cargo build --release --manifest-path launcher/Cargo.toml --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu && cp launcher/target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/aiot dist/aiot-linux-x64
scripts.build:linux-arm64: bun build src/cli.ts --compile --target bun-linux-arm64 --outfile dist/aiot-runtime-linux-arm64 && cargo build --release --manifest-path launcher/Cargo.toml --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu && cp launcher/target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/aiot dist/aiot-linux-arm64
